closure_mapping.original_gap: Before R4 (R3 at 1426c2a) the normal current.freeze -> Consumer.consume path with no registry capability produced a COMPLETE OPEN TradeIntent (capability_receipt_id None) that Risk APPROVED in the normal-source fixture. This is the real normal path, not a synthetic allocator fixture; see gap-probe.txt. The entry-authority gate at execution is separate and unchanged.
closure_mapping.r4_contract: LUFFY-PORTFOLIO-ALLOCATOR-R4 requires exactly one frozen entry-capability:<instrument> for NEW_POSITION: entry-capability.v1 schema, receipt digest, exact instrument and market, observed_at <= cut <= valid_until, account trading ENABLED, account ELIGIBLE, venue TRADING, SHORT needs shortability PROVEN. Missing -> INCOMPLETE (ENTRY_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE); stale/ineligible/invalid/ambiguous -> BLOCKED. KEEP/FLAT/SUPPORTS_EXISTING are ungated. No threshold, no venue call, no UNKNOWN -> zero.
closure_mapping.whole_book: One frozen cut carries holdings, every eligible candidate, account state, capability sources, portfolio snapshot id and CASH. Every candidate gets an opportunity-cost comparison against the book; CASH is always available. A capability-less economics-9 candidate cannot beat a capability-valid economics-2 candidate: R4 selects the latter while R3 on the same inputs would have chosen the former.
closure_mapping.cash_fail_closed: Missing/UNKNOWN economics, missing bounds, missing costs, UNKNOWN portfolio, unavailable Risk policy, FROZEN control and missing capability each select CASH with proposed_size UNAVAILABLE and a NO_ACTION intent with null requested size. Unavailable never becomes zero.
closure_mapping.normal_caller: current.freeze reads the capability recorded by the kernel (market instrument binding, cross-checked against the entry-authority kv record) and freezes entry-capability:<instrument>; a change during the read refuses PROPOSAL_CAPABILITY_CHANGED_DURING_READ. Consumer.consume -> allocate -> trade_intent.build binds the exact receipt -> risk_intent.evaluate. No manual priming in the normal-path tests. Absent or stale capability yields CASH and no OPEN intent.
closure_mapping.authority_boundary: Every TradeIntent keeps risk_final_authority=true, execution_routed=false, risk_approval=NOT_REQUESTED, side_effects=NONE. Portfolio grants no Risk approval, execution, venue, order, leverage or final-quantity authority; quantity/notional/leverage stay with Risk and entry_authority, which reread the trusted capability. The allocator capability digest is the entry_authority digest. Portfolio modules import no venue/executor/exits/protective/orchestrator.
closure_mapping.versioning_replay: R2, R3 and R4 are distinct, non-substitutable and all supported by verify. R2/R3 result bytes are identical between the pre-R4 base and the R4 tree on five input shapes; no historical receipt rewritten. R4 ordering is stable under candidate and source permutations; a stale or swapped cut refuses.
closure_mapping.scope_limit: Architecture/offline scope; capability fixtures are TEST-ONLY synthetic authorities built through register_capability. No deployed, live, provider or venue proof. Engineering commit is on branch port01-whole-book (base 1426c2a) and is not merged by this reconciliation.
